items.trigger: What is the average timeline for a project?
items.content: It depends on complexity. A landing page takes 7 to 14 days; a complete SaaS takes 6 to 12 weeks. I define a detailed schedule during discovery before development starts.
Every project includes 30 days of free support after launch. I fix bugs, answer questions, and make small adjustments at no extra cost during this period.
Yes. I offer monthly maintenance and improvement plans for clients who need regular updates, new features, or continuous monitoring.
Each project receives a custom quote based on its scope, timeline, and technical complexity. I work with fixed project fees — no surprises on the invoice.

items.trigger: Can I track progress during development?
items.content: Yes. I use a staging environment available throughout development, with regular updates and direct communication via WhatsApp.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.body: This Privacy Policy describes how Samuel Oliveira de Araujo (Brazilian taxpayer ID 12.345.678/0001-90) collects, uses, and protects your information when you use this website and professional portfolio. Your privacy is very important to us, and we are committed to protecting the personal data you share with us.

sections.title: 2. Information collection
sections.body: We collect only the information strictly necessary to provide and improve our services:

items.label: Contact data:
items.body: We collect your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you voluntarily submit through the contact form to request a quote or ask questions.

items.label: Browsing data:
items.body: We collect anonymized statistical data about site use, such as visited pages, time spent, browser type, and traffic source, through Google Analytics solely to optimize the user experience.

sections.title: 3. Use of data
sections.body: We use the data we collect exclusively for the following purposes:

items.body: Replying to your messages, questions, or quote requests.
Providing technical support or clarification regarding contracted projects.
Continuously analyzing and improving the portfolio’s performance and usability.

sections.title: 4. Sharing and storage
sections.body: We do not sell, rent, trade, or share your personally identifiable information with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data is stored securely and retained only as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or as required by law.

sections.title: 5. Information security
sections.body: We implement reasonable technical and administrative security measures to protect your data from loss, theft, unauthorized access, disclosure, or alteration. However, no internet transmission or electronic storage method is 100% secure.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: Under Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you may request confirmation of data processing, access your stored data, correct incomplete or inaccurate data, or request deletion of your information from our database. To exercise these rights, contact us through our service channels.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: If you have questions, suggestions, or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us through the form on the home page or directly by institutional support email.
